statement.zh-TW: 日暮文具社付給銀行的利息，會在算營業利益之前就扣掉。
statement.en: The interest Sunset Stationery pays its bank is deducted before operating profit is worked out.

feedbackTrue.zh-TW: 利息確實是一筆支出，這點沒錯。不過它是借錢的代價，和賣文具的本業無關，所以放在營業外支出，在營業利益之後才扣。
feedbackTrue.en: Interest is indeed a cost, you are right about that. But it is the price of borrowing and has nothing to do with selling stationery, so it sits under non-operating expenses and is deducted after operating profit.

feedbackFalse.zh-TW: 答對了。營業利益只反映本業；利息是借錢的代價，歸在營業外支出，從營業利益往下走到經常利益時才扣。
feedbackFalse.en: That's right. Operating profit reflects only the core business; interest is the price of borrowing and belongs under non-operating expenses, deducted on the way from operating profit to ordinary profit.

explanation.zh-TW: 營業利益回答「本業賺不賺」，所以只扣營業成本與銷管費用。利息、攤銷這類業外項目要到下一層：營業利益加營業外收入、減營業外支出，得到經常利益。
explanation.en: Operating profit answers whether the core business earns money, so it deducts only cost of sales and distribution costs and administrative expenses. Non-operating items such as interest and amortisation come at the next level: operating profit plus non-operating income less non-operating expenses gives ordinary profit.
